
```{r setup}
library(ABAData)
library(ggplot2)
library(scuttle)
```


Create a SingleCellExperiment object with 70k cells and normalize counts.
```{r}
x <- ABAMouseSSv4("/mnt/Data/Bioinfo_platf/wyss_project/docker_envi/Rpackages/data/ABAMouseSSv4/")
x <- scuttle::logNormCounts(x)
```

# Standard plotting
```{r}
scater::plotUMAP(x,colour_by="subclass_label",text_by="subclass_label",add_legend=FALSE,point_size=0.3,text_size=3) +
  coord_equal()
scater::plotUMAP(x,colour_by="Gad1",point_size=0.3) + coord_equal()
scater::plotDots(x,c("Gad1","Gad2","Neurod1","Neurod2"),group = "subclass_label") + coord_flip()
scater::plotExpression(x,c("Gad2","Neurod2"))
scater::plotGroupedHeatmap(x,c("Gad1","Gad2","Neurod1","Neurod2"),group = "subclass_label")
```



# Custom plotting
```{r}
makePerCellDF(x) |>
  ggplot() +
    geom_point(aes(x=UMAP.1,y=UMAP.2,color=subclass_color),size=0.3) + 
    scale_color_identity() + 
    coord_equal() +
    theme_classic()
```


# Dimensionality reduction
```{r,eval=FALSE}
BPPARAM <- BiocParallel::MulticoreParam(6,progressbar = TRUE)
x <- scater::runPCA(x,BPPARAM=BPPARAM)
x <- scater::runUMAP(x,dimred="PCA",BPPARAM=BPPARAM,name="U")
```

## Clustering
```{r}
k <- scran::clusterCells(x,use.dimred="UMAP",BLUSPARAM=bluster::NNGraphParam(shared = FALSE,k=30),full=TRUE)
x$my_cluster <- igraph::cut_at(k$objects$communities,no=50)
```


```{r}
scater::plotUMAP(x,colour_by="my_cluster",text_by="my_cluster",add_legend=FALSE,point_size=0.3,text_size=3)
```

```{r}
BPPARAM <- BiocParallel::MulticoreParam(6,progressbar = TRUE)
markers <- scran::findMarkers(x,x$class_label,test.type="wilcox",pval.type="any",BPPARAM=BPPARAM)
```

```{r}
scater::plotDots(x,rownames(markers$GABAergic)[1:20],group = "class_label")
```
